description: One stdlib SuctionCup (the 1.5-fold bellows of fanuc-pick, nonlinear bellows on) on a prescribed-motion tool holds a 0.6 kg box: hold and release, a vertical bounce, horizontal acceleration steps, a tool-tilt swing, a lateral chirp, an overload and the nonlinear cup next to the linear one. design/analysis.py derives the operating vacuum, the static hold with the vacuum lift stroke, the axial and lateral/tilt modes and the quasi-static utilisations; the checks pin the simulations to those numbers and pin which runs hold and which lose the box.

checks.note: operating vacuum: the ejector curve Q_max (1 - dp/dp_max) meets the sealed-lip leak at 59.15 kPa (analysis.operating_vacuum)
holding capacity A_eff dp = 5e-4 m^2 x 59.15 kPa

static hold: k_ax ext + A_fold dp = m g gives ext = (5.884 - 10.056 N) / 2500 N/m = -1.668 mm; the vacuum lift stroke (4.022 mm unloaded) is larger than the sag, so the hanging cup is shorter than its rest length
side-stiffness factor (1 + c_vac dp/p_atm) exp(-c_ext ext/L0) at the hang
static utilisation m g / (A_eff dp)
before the robot moves, the lift stroke lifts the box 1.668 mm off the table (resting centre 19.962 mm + 1.668 mm)
the lift and the lowering stay far from the holding limit (max 0.283)
the box was held until the release
the release vents the cup
the tool retracts after the release: the lip leaves the box
the ring-down after the 4 mm step: w_n = sqrt(k_ax/m) = 64.55 rad/s (10.27 Hz), zeta = d_ax / (2 sqrt(k_ax m)) = 0.103 (no bottoming at the hang)
the step ring (ext down to -2.96 mm) stays inside the 6 mm stroke: no bottoming
in the vertical chirp the folds bottom (ext to -7.4 mm): the hardening bends the resonance up, so the largest push comes at about 13.9 Hz, above the 10.27 Hz linear mode
the seal survives the bottoming (max U 0.87)
held
the coast after the 1.5 m/s^2 pulse rings the sway mode: 6.55 Hz from the linearised two-degree-of-freedom model (lateral bellows deflection and box tilt, side stiffness x kf 1.87)
and the tilt mode at 13.20 Hz
the sway mode again after the 4.5 m/s^2 stop
max U 0.90 at the 4.5 m/s^2 pulse: the quasi-static value is 0.61, the sudden pulse overshoots
the lip never lifts
held
the tool holds 30 degrees
quasi-static tilt: the shear m g sin 30 deg over k_lat kf, with kf at the axial load m g cos 30 deg: 1.016 mm
quasi-static utilisation at 30 degrees: (m g cos + 4 m g sin h / D_lip + m g sin / mu) / Fcap = 0.620
the fast +-10 degree swing at 1.5 Hz peaks at U 0.84
held

transmissibility peak at the sway mode (fl 6.6 Hz); the swept, demodulated peak is lower than the steady-state 4.58 of the linear model because the 1.85 Hz/s sweep crosses the resonance in a few cycles
and at the tilt mode (fl 13.4 Hz)
max U 0.71 at the tilt resonance
held
the 0.8 kg box survives the 3 m/s^2 move (max U 0.87)
still sealed at the start of the 6 m/s^2 pulse
in the 6 m/s^2 pulse (quasi-static U 0.996)
U reaches 1, the lip peels, the gap passes h_lost: the seal is lost at 2.51 s
lost for good
the box fell off before the release
nonlinear cup at the hang: (m g - A_fold dp) / k_ax = -1.668 mm
linear cup: m g / k_ax = +2.354 mm; the difference is the lift stroke A_fold dp / k_ax = 4.022 mm, so the nonlinear box hangs 4 mm higher
small motions: both cups ring at the same 10.27 Hz axial mode (same k_ax, no bottoming)
in the chirp the nonlinear cup bottoms: the lift stroke has used 1.7 mm of the 6 mm compression travel
the linear cup has no bottoming
the nonlinear cup holds (max U 0.87)
the linear cup holds (max U 0.64)
